places.shortDescriptionEn: Beachfront Italian dining on Petitenget.

Area: Petitenget. Pantai Petitenget / Jl. Kayu Aya foreshore — beside Pura Petitenget (not Legian or Kuta Beach)

places.shortDescriptionEn: Core Seminyak beach for surf and sunset.
places.descriptionEn:
Seminyak’s main beach strip for surfing and sunsets, quieter by day than Kuta yet part of the same continuous southwest coast sand. Official Indonesia Travel notes Seminyak Beach as favored for surfable waves and ocean panoramas. Not interchangeable with Legian or Kuta village centers.

Area: Seminyak. Central Seminyak beach access (e.g. near Jl. Dhyana Pura / Camplung Tanduk) — continuous sand south toward Legian/Kuta but not the same destination as Kuta Beach village
